text: This lesson is about Q-Learning. Recall that Q-Learning is a model-free approach, meaning that it does not know about or use models of the transitions T or the rewards R. Instead, Q-Learning builds a table of utility values as the agent interacts with the world. These Q-values can be used at each step to select the best action based on what it has learned so far. The fantastic thing about Q-Learning is that it is guaranteed to provide an optimal policy. There is a hitch, however, that we'll cover later.
